M60.legacy_comparison: November 19 same 16 schools: 4 served; after #1280 15 of 16 each received one attempt. Remaining Syracuse request, future cross-rotation fairness and 14-day coverage require later natural runs.

unattributed_outcomes.detail: All 117 published shards were searched. The 15 attempts count and the school request/attempt counters are preserved in collector_status.condition_refresh. For the three schools individual direct receipts are absent in the original and corrected release snapshots during the condition-pass interval. The aggregate records no per-ID or per-department attribution for these three. The run attached no artifact. The following hygiene phase reports 237 duplicates removed and 8 previously published duplicates archived, but the logs do not establish why any particular receipt was omitted.

publication: Only the automatic PR merge step failed. The data from the completed collection and the reconciled release were merged in PR #1464 at 18:52 UTC. The production deployment receipt at 18:54:41 UTC belongs to the reconciled commit.
